title: aster nuttallii var. fendleri
intro: Aster nuttallii var. fendleri, commonly known as Fendler's aster or prairie aster, is a perennial plant species within the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Fendler's aster include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe wounds and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Fendler's aster include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
